title: Python Fundamentals
description: A comprehensive introduction to Python programming, covering foundational syntax, control structures, functional programming, error handling, and object-oriented principles.
outcomes: Understand Python execution architecture and syntax
Master primitive and collection data types
Control program flow with loops and conditionals
Write modular functions with robust exception handling
Build object-oriented software with classes and inheritance

lessons.title: Introduction to Python
lessons.content: Python is a high-level interpreted programming language emphasizing readability, clean syntax, and significant indentation.

lessons.title: Variables and Data Types
lessons.content: Dynamic typing in Python, primitive types (int, float, bool, str), and collections (lists, tuples, dicts, sets).

lessons.title: Conditional Statements and Loops
lessons.content: Boolean logic, if-elif-else branching, while loops, for loops with range, loop-else constructs, and list comprehensions.

lessons.title: Functions and Exception Handling
lessons.content: Function definition with def, positional and keyword arguments, *args/**kwargs, try-except-else-finally blocks, and raising exceptions.

lessons.title: Object-Oriented Programming
lessons.content: Classes and instances, constructor __init__, self parameter, encapsulation, inheritance, polymorphism, and dunder methods.

title: Machine Learning Foundations
description: Essential principles of modern machine learning, spanning supervised and unsupervised learning paradigms, training and validation methodologies, loss functions, evaluation metrics, and regularization.
outcomes: Distinguish machine learning from deterministic rule-based systems
Identify regression, classification, clustering, and dimensionality reduction tasks
Implement robust train-test splits and cross-validation strategies
Evaluate models using MSE, RMSE, R-squared, Precision, Recall, and F1-score
Mitigate overfitting using L1 Lasso, L2 Ridge, and ElasticNet regularization

lessons.title: Introduction to Machine Learning
lessons.content: Definitions of machine learning, features vs targets, model parameters vs hyperparameters, and the standard ML lifecycle.

lessons.title: Supervised and Unsupervised Learning
lessons.content: Supervised regression and classification versus unsupervised clustering (K-Means, DBSCAN) and dimensionality reduction (PCA).

lessons.title: Training and Testing Datasets
lessons.content: Train-test splitting, validation sets, K-fold cross-validation, stratified sampling, and avoiding data leakage.

lessons.title: Model Evaluation
lessons.content: Quantitative evaluation metrics: MAE, MSE, RMSE, R-squared for regression; Confusion matrix, Accuracy, Precision, Recall, F1, and ROC-AUC for classification.

lessons.title: Overfitting and Regularization
lessons.content: Bias-variance tradeoff, overfitting diagnostics, L1 Lasso weight sparsity, L2 Ridge shrinkage, and ElasticNet regularization.

title: Web Development
description: Modern full-stack web engineering, from foundational HTML5, CSS3, and ES6+ JavaScript to reactive component architectures with React, backend services with Node.js and Express, and robust RESTful API design.
outcomes: Construct accessible semantic layouts with HTML5 and CSS3 box model
Write modern asynchronous JavaScript with Promises and async/await
Build single-page web applications using React components and JSX
Manage component state and lifecycle using React Hooks
Develop HTTP server routes and middleware pipelines with Node.js and Express

lessons.title: HTML, CSS and JavaScript Fundamentals
lessons.content: Semantic HTML5, CSS box model, Flexbox, Grid, and modern ES6+ JavaScript (let/const, arrow functions, promises, async/await).

lessons.title: Introduction to React
lessons.content: Single Page Applications, declarative UI, JSX transpilation, Virtual DOM diffing, reconciliation, and unidirectional data flow.

lessons.title: Components and State Management
lessons.content: Functional components, React Hooks (useState, useEffect, useRef), lifting state up, and Context API.

lessons.title: Node.js and Express
lessons.content: Node.js V8 runtime, event loop, libuv thread pool, Express HTTP servers, route handlers, and request/response lifecycle.

lessons.title: REST APIs and Middleware
lessons.content: REST architectural principles, HTTP methods, status codes, Express middleware pipelines (req, res, next), authentication, and error handling.
